name: Traveling Trader
title: Produce Row
examine: Road dust on the boots, a stall's worth of somewhere else on the table, and eyes that price you the moment you say hello.
lines: Fresh off the First Road — what the fen didn't take, you're looking at. Amberford's the only market worth stopping for between here and the mountain.
The trick to this town? Learn a trade before you leave it. Bretta, Tilo, Elowen — three masters on one lane. You won't see that again till Silverfall.
We sleep at the Wanderer's Rest and sell by the Round. Dunna's stew, Merra's prices, and a dry bed — a body could do worse than linger here.
